row.evidence: Panther's docs say it "supports managing users via System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) with Okta", but "does not support creating new users via SCIM"; there is no public price list (panther.com/pricing redirects to the product overview).
row.notes: Quote-only: Panther publishes no plans or prices; /pricing redirects to the overview page and the site offers demo requests only. SCIM is documented for Okta only and covers profile updates, role (PantherRole attribute) and deactivate/reactivate of users already created by SAML JIT; it cannot create or delete users and has no /Groups endpoint, so it would be partial if it were not quote-only. Panther's own SAML overview page still lists SCIM as unsupported (see conflicts). SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, Google, OneLogin, Duo, generic) with JIT auto-provisioning; plan placement of SSO is not published. Panther is now part of Databricks and is being folded into Databricks Lakewatch. REST and GraphQL user/role APIs are available with an API token holding Manage Users.

scim.base_url: Tenant URL shown in Panther Console > General Settings > Identity & Access > SCIM Provisioning Setup

auth.token_source: Panther Console > Settings > Developer Tools > API Tokens (token with Manage Users / UserModify), sent as the Authorization HTTP header
auth.notes: Okta 'HTTP Header' auth mode with the Panther API token pasted as Authorization; docs do not state the prefix or expiry.

operations.notes: Update is documented as Okta 'Push Profile Updates'; the HTTP method (PUT vs PATCH) is not stated. 'read' inferred from documented eq queries.

filtering.notes: Only the eq operator; filterable attributes not listed.

custom.how: Add an Okta profile attribute pantherRole (external namespace urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User) carrying a Panther role name

roles.how: pantherRole attribute on the Okta app user; applies at the user's next Okta login

limitations.text: Okta only; users must first be created by SAML JIT on their first login, and existing users cannot be imported.
No user deletion and no /Groups endpoint; only eq filters.
Console edits to users are overwritten on the next Okta sync once SCIM is enabled.
Role changes pushed by SCIM take effect only after the user re-authenticates via Okta.

user_api.base_url: Per-instance API URL shown in Panther Console > Settings > Developer Tools > API Tokens

limitations.text: Only an Admin can delete other Admin users; self-deletion is not supported.

user_api.notes: Also a GraphQL API (GraphQL-over-HTTP or the Console API Playground) with the same user and role operations.

okta.notes: Panther's docs use a custom 'Create App Integration' SAML 2.0 app with SCIM enabled, not an OIN catalogue app; okta.com/integrations/panther returned 404.

entra.notes: Entra setup uses a non-gallery app; SSO only.

conflicts.text: Panther's SAML overview lists SCIM under 'Panther does not support the following', while the Okta SCIM page documents SCIM profile updates and deactivation via Okta. The more specific Okta SCIM page is used.

open_questions: No public pricing or plan list; which contracts include SSO and SCIM is not published.
SCIM token expiry and Authorization header format (Bearer prefix or raw key) are not documented.
Whether SCIM deactivation ends active Panther sessions or frees a seat is not documented.
REST API rate limits are not documented on the pages read.
Whether Panther is listed in the Okta OIN, JumpCloud or Entra gallery could not be confirmed.
